summary:
# 每日彙整報告

## 📰 今日重點摘要
1. 比特幣冷錢包攻擊擴散至4,500個地址，損失接近8900萬美元，引起業界廣泛關注。
2. 俄羅斯法令禁止莫斯科地區的加密貨幣挖礦至2032年，顯示政府對加密行業的嚴厲態度。
3. 美國證券交易委員會將審查納斯達克比特幣期權批准，可能影響市場流動性。
4. 明尼蘇達州對加密貨幣ATM實施禁令，因報告損失達100萬美元。
5. 加密貨幣政治行動委員會再向密歇根州眾議院選舉投入100萬美元，顯示行業對政策影響的重視。

## 📊 市場概況
今日整體市場氛圍偏向疲弱，恐懼貪婪指數僅為27，顯示市場情緒普遍悲觀。主流幣方面，比特幣（BTC）報價$62796，輕微下跌0.1%；以太坊（ETH）則報價$1846.19，下跌0.8%。BNB表現相對穩定，雖然下跌1.8%，價格為$575.65。Solana（SOL）和XRP同樣出現下滑，分別為$71.89和$1.06，這顯示出整體市場承壓。

## 🔍 技術分析解讀
比特幣（BTC）的相對強弱指數（RSI）為46.57，顯示出中性偏弱的市場情況，並且均線訊號顯示空頭趨勢。以太坊（ETH）RSI為51.28，接近中性，均線訊號則顯示多頭，顯示出一定的上漲潛力。BNB的RSI為53.91，顯示出略為強勢的趨勢，而SOL和XRP的RSI分別在34.4和42.99，顯示出明顯的空頭壓力。

## 😱 市場情緒
目前市場情緒相對悲觀，恐懼貪婪指數為27，顯示出市場參與者對未來走勢的擔憂。社群對於比特幣冷錢包攻擊的消息反應強烈，許多投資者開始重新評估資產安全性。此外，加密貨幣挖礦禁令的消息也引發了對潛在政策風險的擔憂。

## ⚠️ 風險提醒
隨著比特幣冷錢包攻擊事件的持續擴大，投資者需特別注意資產安全性，建議選擇安全性更高的儲存方式。此外，政策變動的潛在風險也不容忽視，特別是在俄羅斯等國家對加密貨幣的嚴厲管制可能對市場造成重大影響。

## 🎯 今日觀察重點
投資者應密切關注比特幣冷錢包攻擊的後續發展，以及美國證券交易委員會對比特幣期權的審查結果。此外，需留意明尼蘇達州對加密貨幣ATM禁令的執行情況，這可能成為其他州行動的先例。最後，市場情緒的變化也值得關注，特別是在高波動性的市場環境中。

news.title: Strategy holds STRC dividend at 12%

news.title: Iran-linked exchange sent $676 million to Binance in alleged sanctions-evasion operation: Reuters
news.summary: Dubai-based Shelbit processed over $4 billion since May 2024 through a network tied to Iranian gambling sites, the central bank, and the IRGC, per Reuters.

news.title: Onchain, in court: What happened in crypto legal news this week
news.summary: A case tied to defunct crypto exchange FTX moves forward, a soldier seeks to dismiss over a Polymarket bet and a former congressman was ordered to pay $35,000 for manipulative trading.
news.title_zh: 鏈上法律：本週加密貨幣法律新聞回顧

news.title: Bitcoin cold-wallet attack spreads to 4,500 addresses as losses near $89 million
news.title_zh: 比特幣冷錢包攻擊擴散至 4,500 個地址，損失接近 8900 萬美元

news.title: BNB Chain ‘pursuing legal action’ against former employee over memecoin launched from tutorial wallet
news.summary: Lookonchain said the former employee bought nearly 80% of ASTEROID's supply for $10,000 before selling most of the tokens for about $638,000.

news.title: Minnesota crypto ATM ban goes into effect after reported $1M losses
news.summary: State officials reported that Minnesota residents, and largely senior citizens, had lost about $1 million from scams tied to crypto kiosks from 2023 to 2025.
news.title_zh: 明尼蘇達州加密貨幣 ATM 禁令生效，因報告損失達 100 萬美元

news.title: Tokenized stock trading surged 288% in July, but one QQQ token drove most of it
news.title_zh: 代幣化股票交易在 7 月激增 288%，但一個 QQQ 代幣主導了大部分交易

news.title: Russian decree bans crypto mining across Moscow region through 2032
news.summary: Regional energy officials had estimated that mining consumes 1 GW of power and could contribute to future electricity shortages.
news.title_zh: 俄羅斯法令禁止莫斯科地區的加密貨幣挖礦至 2032 年

news.title: CZ Warns Bitcoin Holders After $70 Million Wallet Exploit: 'Nothing Is 100%'
news.summary: The Binance founder urged holders to spread funds across multiple wallets as Galaxy Research put the toll from the Coldcard exploit at roughly $70 million—nearly double the initial estimate.

news.summary_zh: CZ 對比特幣持有者發出警告，強調加密資產的風險和不確定性。

news.title: Bank of Italy research suggests stablecoins aren't necessarily cheaper for remittances

news.summary_zh: 意大利銀行的研究指出，穩定幣在匯款方面的成本優勢並不明顯。

news.summary: Gallup says Americans are growing more skeptical of artificial intelligence, with rising concerns about job losses, businesses' use of the technology, and the technology’s growing impact.

news.title: Solana Foundation's new CISO warns AI is making crypto scams more convincing

news.summary: Galaxy Research identified 1,196 addresses that lost 1,082.65 Bitcoin in a 41-minute window, expanding the estimated scope of the Coldcard wallet incident.
news.title_zh: 根據Galaxy分析，Coldcard比特幣損失估計上升至7000萬美元
